title: Ecobee HVAC Runtime Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: LG ThinQ washer cycles (`thinq:washer`), LG ThinQ dryer cycles (`thinq:dryer`), Home Connect dishwasher runs (`homeconnect:dishwasher`), and ecobee HVAC runtime (`ecobee:thermostat`).
app: LG ThinQ washer and dryer telemetry, Home Connect dishwasher data, and ecobee HVAC runtime exported into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ecobee:thermostat
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by hvac_mode
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>24
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when ecobee HVAC runtime data has stopped arriving for a given HVAC mode.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per HVAC mode and alert when the feed is older than 24 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers when one part of your ecobee HVAC runtime feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
